review.notes: Full review. All 9 findings of the previous review (9b02adb) are repaired. Gate passes at 1fae7cd; depcheck 0 problems (no UPWARD, no CYCLE); Suggested.lean elaborates with 6 sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closes none of the 6 theorems; 10 signatures compared with the README. Seeded sample of 11 targets read on Kal80 (GDZ scan, pp. 279-293) and GKRW25 (arXiv v3). Findings: P1 stabiliser count in 1.1 false for non-square groups (Kal80 Examples 3.5.2-4); P2 3.1's degree does not require tau injective, 3.3 fails on a truncated constant system; P3 2.3 holds without connectedness (finite products, Kunneth); P3 2.4 Needs omits StableHomotopyKTheory 1.14, 3.12, 3.16, 3.31 and AlgebraicKTheory 4.1; P3 process narrative in Scope and Downstream. Nesterenko-Suslin 1989 and Guin 1989 not opened (confirmed through GKRW25).
